rationale_bullets: Becht arrives as 'the most experienced FBS quarterback' (Athlon): 39 career starts, 26 wins, 2,500+ snaps; 2nd in P4 career yardage, 3rd in passing TD (P6). His down-year 2025 (2,584 @ 60.5%, 16-9) still tape-graded 80.0 PFF/409 (B12 +6 -> 86.0, ~p82 tape).

The continuity is unique for a coach-change build: his OC (Mouser), top two WRs, top two TEs, and RB all transferred with him - the scheme install risk that normally taxes a new-HC QB is largely pre-paid.

The tempering: 'his deep ball is excellent, but he'll need to hit the shorter lay-ups with more consistency' (P6); a genuine down year by raw line; offseason surgery on the NON-throwing shoulder limited spring (VR-headset reps - Athlon).
Depth is thin: Manske (64.6/8, came from Ames) and FR Falzone behind him.

74, H = the third QB situation of the B10 round (Sayin 91, Moore 89 clear; Indiana 70 below): a 39-start veteran with top-quintile adjusted tape, graded under his tape percentile for the raw-line dip and the B12->B10 jump.

key_players.name: Rocco Becht
key_players.evidence: 80.0 PFF/409 2025 at ISU (B12 +6 -> 86.0); 39 career starts, 26 wins

rationale_bullets: The record duo is gone - Allen (89.7/210; school rushing record 4,180; All-American; rd-6 WAS) + Singleton (school TD record 45) - and the staff imported a complete replacement pair.
Hansen (77.9/188 at ISU, B12 +7 -> 84.9): 952 @ 5.1, All-B12 2nd team, 'between-the-tackles workhorse' (P6) - Becht's own back, in Mouser's power-run scheme.
Peoples (76.3/62 at Ohio State; Top100; 'home-run explosiveness' - P6) + returning Martin (62.4/20; bowl star 20-103; PS#3 '24 recruit) + Wallace (Withdrawn override STAYS).
PS: 'this unit remains strong despite the loss of two career-leading RBs.'
68, M: weighted aggregate ~80 (~p78 tape) discounted for modest samples (188 B12 att + 62 OSU att) and the line rebuild in front of them.

P6's structural frame: 'this position has held back the Penn State offense for several years and it's another restart after last year's top four all departed' (Pena 75.0/288, Ross 70.3/246, Hudson 59.0/262 all yr4; Reynolds -> VT).
The counter is chemistry: Becht's own top targets came with him - C.Sowell (65.6/264 -> 68.6; three straight 500-yd seasons, B12 Newcomer) + Eskildsen (66.6/263 -> 69.6; led ISU with 526/5).

The TE room is the strength: Brahmer (65.7/298 -> 68.7; #2 TE transfer, Mackey semifinalist, 6'7 - 'will continue the program's recent string of draft picks' - Athlon) + Burkle (58.9/195 -> 61.9) + returning Top100 Rappleyea (63.0/139).
No alpha anywhere in the room; Howard (63.8/84, ex-4*) is the top returning WR tape.
58, M: weighted aggregate ~66.5 sits ON the Nebraska-50 anchor (66.4); graded up to 58 for the TE depth, the QB-familiarity carryover, and proven mid-tier volume across five bodies.

Four starters and 122 career starts left - Ioane (79.6/614; FIRST-ROUND; yr3 declare override), Shelton (70.6/721; rd-4), Dawkins (70.3/723), Rucci (75.3/611) - taking the as-played PBLK 89p / RBLK 87p with them.

The rebuilt interior is proven: Riker (71.7/868 at Texas State, SBC -0; Campbell: 'could be the best C in the FBS' - PS) + Buhr (64.5/453 at ISU, B12 +8 -> 72.5; All-B12; 'a lock at guard' - P6) + Cousins (67.5/177; bowl G starter).

The tackles are the seam: Donkoh (69.3/693 -> 68.3), the ONLY returning starter, moves G->T; LT1 is a no-tape FR (Goodman) over Aliciene (75.2/22 tiny); P6: 'the offensive line needs a crash course in preseason camp.'
PS: 'figure to be down a notch' vs Campbell's ISU 'absolute strength' - and Campbell's OL-development record (16 NFL picks off 8 four-stars at ISU) is the qualitative upside case.
58, M: projected-starter aggregate ~67 (~p52) with a FR LT and a converted RT; graded just above p50 on the proven interior, well under the proxy's departed-tape 78.

The entire ISU trio imported at full volume: Bacon (70.2/652, B12 +5 -> 75.2; 4* transfer) + Ebel (64.1/664 -> 69.1; 2-yr MLB starter; 17.5 TFL combined with Bacon - Athlon) + Brezina (70.4/328 -> 75.4). Four proven starters for three spots.

The retained cluster is the quiet win of the interim continuity (Terry Smith stayed): Collins (68.3/538 -> 74.3; returning starter CB) + Tracy (63.7/435 -> 69.7; 'Swiss Army knife' - Campbell) + Dixson (78.3/320 -> 84.3; the true-FR surge that 'caused two veterans to transfer out' - P6).
